description: This is a vintage armchair with a wooden frame and upholstered seat and back. The upholstery features a repeating geometric pattern in shades of beige, green, and blue, creating a subtle yet eye-catching design. The wooden frame is simple and functional, with clean lines and a natural wood finish. The armchair appears to be a single-seater, designed for comfort and relaxation. Its design suggests it might be from the mid-20th century, embodying a classic and somewhat retro aesthetic.
